---
name: Idea or exploration
about: Ask a question, suggest an improvement or share an experiment.
---

## What are you curious about?

Describe the problem or possibility. Vibe Coding and AI-assisted experiments are welcome; no particular tool is required.

## Possible direction

Alternatives, a small experiment, and what would count as a useful result. Include compatibility, privacy or accessibility concerns where relevant. It is fine not to have a solution yet.

## Existing work

Related issues, examples or tests, if you found any.
